info.cls_ename: Master's Program in Mechanical Engineering, Department of Mechanical and computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 培養學生閱讀最新文獻，掌握最新技術發展趨勢，培養學生檢索、閱讀論文和發表論文的能力，熟悉相關論文研究課題和內容。 通過參與論文發表和討論，培養學生傾聽、思考、提問，並具備討論專業問題的能力，並與不同專業領域的學生進行有效溝通。
description.describe_eh: Train students read the latest literature to grasp the latest technological development trends, cultivate students' ability to retrieve, read papers and publish papers, and make them familiar with relevant paper research topics and content. Through their participation in paper presentation and discussion to train students to listen, think, ask questions, and have the ability to discuss professional issues and effectively communicate with students in different professional fields.
